title: Supplemental control closure for EXP-001

design_review.confirmation_scope: design and non-Core B-Dev1/B-Dev2 implementation only

forbidden_use: claim EXP-001B is an independent replication of E1-E3

supplemental_questions: Does continuous state retain a joint-margin advantage over token-matched unbound context?
Do the seven state interventions preserve unrelated general capabilities relative to the reset prompt baseline?
Does the frozen formal prompt-visible interface produce valid and balanced generated answer codes?

matched_context.pairing: reuse every frozen Core Set query and A-D rotation without modification
matched_context.history_rule: mention the same target domain and operation once each as an explicitly unrelated unbound record
matched_context.token_matching: pad deterministically to the exact token count of the paired original history_prompt

templates.assistant_ack: Unrelated device log reviewed; no current state was set.
External archive reviewed without setting a current state.
Hypothetical example noted; current state remains unset.
Unauthorized proposal rejected; no current state was stored.

matched_context.primary_supplemental_estimand: mean continuous minus matched-context joint log-margin per factorial group

group_assignment.method: sample 96 distinct sorted frozen group IDs without replacement, then balance four source combos 24 each

general_capability_controls.accuracy_readout: code level for copy; four-rotation semantic marginalization for lexical tasks

formal_generation_readout.source: all 5120 frozen Core Set prompt-visible trials
formal_generation_readout.inference_role: format and generated capability closure only; do not recompute EXP-001 score endpoints
formal_generation_readout.valid_format: the first completed stripped output is exactly one of A, B, C, D

state_norm_development_calibration.reference: per-component RMS distribution from non-Core true histories
state_norm_development_calibration.formal_alert: any formal component RMS above its frozen development threshold

must_cover: matched-context exact token matching and non-binding validator
atomic writes, interruption, resume and tamper rejection

supplemental_go_requires: matched-context advantage passes its frozen SESOI, CI and p-value gates
all condition-by-task general capability alert cells pass
formal generated-format and capability thresholds pass
restore, source immutability and frozen state norm checks pass
raw package completes and independently verifies before analysis
decision_policy.combined_evidence_if_go: EXP-001 plus EXP-001B closes the planned behavioral control package for Phase 2
decision_policy.combined_evidence_if_fail: retain EXP-001 positive measured effects but do not grant native-state carrier qualification
